request.style: English, Christmas lullaby, a young mother's tender soprano, harp, celesta and soft strings, gently rocking 3/4, hushed and wondering, 58 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
Wrapped in cloth and laid in hay
There was no room for us to stay
The shepherds came and knelt to see
The baby sleeping close to me

[Chorus]
Hush now, hush now, little King
The angels told me everything
And I will keep these things and ponder
In my heart, in my heart

[Verse]
They told of angels in the sky
Of glory sung to God on high
And all who heard it were amazed
Now sleep while heaven gives you praise

[Chorus]
Hush now, hush now, little King
The angels told me everything
And I will keep these things and ponder
In my heart, in my heart
